<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **11** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **7** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.ts`, `packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**7** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx`  _(via relationshipField (literal, a string literal in RecordLineItemsProps))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`  _(via relationshipField (literal, a string literal in RecordLineItemsProps))_
- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via childObject (literal, a string literal in RecordLineItemsProps), relationshipField (literal, a string literal in RecordLineItemsProps))_
- `content/docs/getting-started/common-patterns.mdx`  _(via relationshipField (literal, a string literal in RecordLineItemsProps))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx`  _(via relationshipField (literal, a string literal in RecordLineItemsProps))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object), childObject (literal, a string literal in RecordLineItemsProps), relationshipField (literal, a string literal in RecordLineItemsProps))_
- `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`  _(via relationshipField (literal, a string literal in RecordLineItemsProps))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **7** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.ts`, `packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **137** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4727fcb22a7e6a28da1ad20ef74469fbabb8dd0e` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `46c31cb17d8f7c4f6c25031b89c9f56e5ee7fa6e` — the merge of head `75f98b26a43fa1d485285b05a0eda306bcc13fb9` into base `4727fcb22a7e6a28da1ad20ef74469fbabb8dd0e`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 46c31cb17d8f7c4f6c25031b89c9f56e5ee7fa6e && git checkout 46c31cb17d8f7c4f6c25031b89c9f56e5ee7fa6e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 4727fcb22a7e6a28da1ad20ef74469fbabb8dd0e 75f98b26a43fa1d485285b05a0eda306bcc13fb9 && git checkout -B drift-repro 4727fcb22a7e6a28da1ad20ef74469fbabb8dd0e && git merge --no-ff 75f98b26a43fa1d485285b05a0eda306bcc13fb9

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4727fcb22a7e6a28da1ad20ef74469fbabb8dd0e
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 4727fcb22a7e6a28da1ad20ef74469fbabb8dd0e` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c2b9101398cce19e72815d0d0837eaa2db672340`
Local-runs: none

Rendered 2026-10-01T21:37Z by an isolated reviewer. Inputs: card #21142 (body and its three comments: the triage grade `5929028089`, the claim `5937827924`, the dev report `5940709575`), PR #21244 (body, 22-file list, net diff `origin/main...refs/review/21142` with the fetched ref equal to the head above), the check-runs on the head, and objectui read-only at the `.objectui-sha` pin `31971ff1e28f` (`git show PIN:PATH`). The dispatch order and the dispatching seat's conclusions were not read. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

**Accept set, before and after.** Before: `record:line_items` had no `ComponentPropsMap` row and was the one entry of `STRING_ARM_REGISTERED_TYPES` (`component-type-vocabulary.ts:68`); the props gate's `if (!schema) continue;` (`validate-component-props.ts:190`) skipped the whole bag, and the page schema types the bag as `z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())` (`page.zod.ts:324`), so ANY key with ANY value parsed clean. After: a strict shape of exactly fifteen keys with `relationshipField` required, `columns` required as `z.array(InlineGridColumnSchema).min(1)`, `childObject` optional, `parentObject` / `parentId` / `recordId` / `amountField` / `totalField` / `title` strings, `readonly` boolean, `minRows` / `maxRows` numbers, `filter` the ViewFilterRule array, `sort` the SortItem array, `limit` a positive integer; near-miss aliases (`object` / `childObjectName` / `child`, `foreignKey` / `relationField` / `parentField`, `fields`, `label`, `sumField`, `rollupField`, `filters`), a guidance reason for `addLabel` / `sortField` / `formFields` / `inlineMode`, and the component-node guidance sets every row shares. RIGHT.

**The fifteen keys, re-measured at the pin.** My own count of distinct `schema.KEY` reads in `plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx` at `31971ff1e28f` is exactly fifteen: `amountField` (2), `childObject` (19), `columns` (1), `filter` (1), `limit` (6), `maxRows` (1), `minRows` (1), `parentId` (1), `parentObject` (1), `readonly` (5), `recordId` (1), `relationshipField` (6), `sort` (2), `title` (1), `totalField` (3). The dev's line citations spot-checked (`:221`, `:228`, `:319`, `:327`, `:341`, `:366`, `:368`, `:377`, `:515`, `:516`, `:667`, `:669`, `:702`-`:707`, `:722`, `:723`, `:778`, `:810`) all hold, and the component's own `LineItemsPanelSchema` interface (`:91`) declares the same fifteen plus `type`. The wrapper adds no key: `ElementDataSourceGate` reads the node-level `dataSource` and composes the same `filter` / `sort` / `limit`; `RECORD_LINE_ITEMS_DATA_SOURCE` (`plugin-form/src/index.tsx:556`) writes the binding's `object` onto `childObject` and `limit` onto `limit`. `requiredPermissions` and `aria` have no read. RIGHT: fifteen declared, none invented, none missing.

**Required keys.** `relationshipField`: `:515` queries `{ [schema.relationshipField]: parentId }` and `:674` hands it to the edit batch; the registration comment says in so many words that it "stays the author's: it is not part of the binding", and nothing on the panel or the gate derives it. RIGHT required. `columns`: `:702` hands `schema.columns` through `applyColumnPermissions` (`fieldWriteGate.ts:307`, a filter-and-lock pass that adds no column) to the grid, where `GridField.tsx:636` reads `cfg.columns || []`; there is no `hydrateColumns` on this path (hydration lives in `deriveMasterDetail.ts` for the master-detail carriers, and `GridField.tsx` names it only in comments). RIGHT required with at least one. `childObject` optional: RIGHT (`index.tsx:557`; `:319` / `:498` guard with a hint when absent).

**The four refused detail-entry keys.** Zero reads of `addLabel` / `sortField` / `formFields` / `inlineMode`, and zero `add_label` / `sort_field` / `onRowExpand`, anywhere in `LineItemsPanel.tsx` at the pin; the grid config it builds (`:694`-`:710`) carries exactly `columns`, `total_field`, `min_rows`, `max_rows`, `allow_add`, `allow_delete`. Refusing them with the master-detail prescription is RIGHT; the shared keys take the detail entry's types and alias table verbatim (compared against `masterDetailDetailEntry()` on `main`, `component.zod.ts:4862`). `parentId` / `recordId` as `z.string()` match the renderer's own interface (`:91` declares both `string`); the master-detail BLOCK's `string | number` `recordId` is a different block's key. RIGHT.

**`columns` by reference.** `shape.columns.element` IS `InlineGridColumnSchema` (asserted by identity in the carrier test). At the pin `fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx` declares `GridColumn` with exactly that schema's twenty keys (`name`, `label`, `type`, `options`, `width`, `required`, `prefix`, `step`, `reference`, `displayField`, `idField`, `multiple`, `accept`, `defaultHidden`, `computed`, `expr`, `scale`, `autofill`, `readonlyWhen`, `requiredWhen`), binds every cell, header and total on `c.name` (`:742`, `:792`, `:871`, `:949`, `:975`-`:988`), and folds nothing from `field`. RIGHT, and the one carrier difference (no hydration) is stated in the `columns` describe. Residual, noted in ③: the column schema's own per-key describes speak of hydration ("defaults to the child field's label via hydration", "derived from the child field's type when omitted", "which hydration copies onto an identity-only column"), and the generated Nested Shape table for this row reproduces them; on THIS carrier those defaults do not happen. The parent row's text contradicts them explicitly, by-reference sharing is the ruled design (triage: not a copy; Zone 2 #4), and neutralising the shared wording is a `data/field.zod.ts` follow-up, not this diff's defect.

**ADR-0087 disposition, measured (its own paragraph).** Four pre-PR shapes were judged against the pinned renderer. (a) A `field`-keyed column, the showcase shape: the grid keys cells on `c.name` and nothing folds `field`, so the shape NEVER worked; empty cells IS the card. A lossless rewrite exists (`field` to `name`) but there is no working old shape for a D2 window to keep loading; the rewrite is a repair, and the D3 entry and the changeset table carry it. (b) A block omitting `relationshipField`: `:515` queries the child by a key spelled `"undefined"` and `:674` writes the FK the same way; never worked, and no mechanical rewrite exists because nothing on this panel derives the FK. (c) A block omitting `columns`, or `columns: []`: `cfg.columns || []` draws a grid with no cells; never useful, no rewrite exists. For (a) to (c) D3-only is RIGHT. (d) Two shapes that DO work at the pin and are refused after: a MongoDB-style record `filter` (`LineItemsPanelSchema.filter?: any[] | Record`, lowered by `toFilterNodeSafely`) and a `sort` entry without `order` (`convertSortToQueryParams` reads it as `asc` and calls that a runtime tolerance, not permission). Both have a lossless rewrite for their mappable part. What "refused" means here is measured, not assumed: the page schema does not parse `properties` (`page.zod.ts:324`), the kernel's authoring-key walk stops dead at that carrier (`metadata-authoring-lint.ts:460`-`:466`), the props gate is `tier: 'advisory'`, `surfaces: CLI_ONLY`, `commands: ALL` (`authoring-rules.ts:1049`-`:1056`, so `validate`, `build` and `lint`), and `applyConversionsToStoredItem` replays without validating. A stored row therefore keeps loading and the renderer keeps honouring both forms; the only new output is an advisory finding to an author running the CLI. The existing D2 `page-component-filter-record-to-rule-array` is gated to `RULE_ARRAY_FILTER_BLOCK_TYPES` (`conversions/registry.ts:12377`: "The `filter` of any other component type is not this entry's surface"), so it does not reach this block, and the sort family's recorded disposition (`18.object-block-sort-item-array`) declines D2 on exactly this stored-row reasoning. Judged: D2 is owed where a working shape stops LOADING; nothing stops loading here, so D3-only with no D2 is RIGHT, the D3 entry's `replacement` names both target forms, and the entry's own sentence "nothing on the load path refuses the shape" is TRUE. Population: zero authored `filter` or `sort` on this block anywhere in the repo (census), deployed metadata NOT MEASURED, stated in the entry. Whether the 2026-09-12 option-B ruling should one day extend that D2's type list to this block is a ruling question raised in ③, not a defect of this diff.

**Public surface, each move for its stated reason.** `api-surface/ui.json` +3 (`RecordLineItemsProps (const)`, `(type)`, `RecordLineItemsPropsParsed (type)`); `export-origins/ui.json` +2 types, the same `(type)`-only pattern `RecordHistoryProps` has; `declaration-map/ui.json` +1; `json-schema.manifest/ui.json` +1; `authorable-surface/ui.json` +15, and the fifteen names are the fifteen keys; `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` adds `ui/RecordLineItemsProps` at `columns.element` (the column schema's currency-scale `.superRefine`) and `filter.element` (the same site `ui/RecordRelatedListProps` carries), counts 213 to 214 and 618 to 620; the strictness ledger counts 189 to 190 and `component.zod.ts` 57 to 58; docs index 166 to 167 and 1522 to 1523, `component.mdx` "44 more". All RIGHT.

**Vocabulary.** `STRING_ARM_REGISTERED_TYPES` becomes `[]` with the export kept; the type is known through its row (`KNOWN_COMPONENT_TYPE_CANDIDATES` folds map keys), is not a `PageComponentType` member, and the ledger-discipline loops now hold vacuously, which the new named pin covers. RIGHT.

**`defineStack` control.** `stack.zod.ts:2808` dispatches `collectHydratedInlineColumnErrors` on `object-master-detail-form` only; with no hydration on this panel there is no resolved type to judge, so not extending it is RIGHT, and the control test asserts both directions (identity-only column with `scale` passes under this block, throws under the master-detail block).

**Lint pins and header edits.** `validate-component-props.ts` changes comments only; the new findings are the spec row reaching the existing dispatch. The pinned paths follow from the emission code: `unrecognized_keys` at `['columns', N]` plus key gives `...properties.columns.N.field` (`:296`-`:320`), the missing `name` gives `component-props-invalid` at `...columns.N.name`. `validate-component-types.test.ts` moves `record:line_items` between two comment groups of one accept list; `validate-page-field-bindings.test.ts` changes a title (its `COMPONENT_FIELD_SPECS` does not carry the type). Behaviour-neutral: RIGHT. No lint changeset is RIGHT (no published lint code moved); no showcase changeset is RIGHT (`private: true`).

**Producer.** Five columns `field` to `name`, each naming a `showcase_task` field, pinned by the new showcase test. RIGHT.

**Published prose, sentence by sentence.** Changeset: every sentence TRUE, including the gate list (verified at `authoring-rules.ts:1052`), the save-and-load sentence (`page.zod.ts:324`), the fifteen-key list, the launch-window level (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs` header; ADR-0087 amendment of 2026-09-13), the census (my grep on `origin/main`: one example block, zero docs blocks, one prose tag-list mention in `ui/react-pages.mdx`). D3 entry strings (`surface`, `replacement`, `reason`, `acceptanceCriteria`): TRUE, including the eight-block control (my count: 1 `record:alert`, 3 `record:details`, 2 `record:highlights`, 1 `record:path`, 1 `record:quick_actions`). `component.mdx` rows: `childObject` hint and no fetch (`:319`, `:778`) TRUE; `relationshipField` query shape and no auto-detect TRUE; `columns` drawn as declared, identity-only is a text cell headed by its name (`GridField.tsx:949`; `:207` and `:217` read `c.type ?? 'text'`) TRUE; `parentObject` default (`:221`) TRUE; `parentId` wins over `recordId` (`:228`) TRUE; `amountField` default `amount` when `totalField` is set (`:669`, `:703`) TRUE at the pin; `totalField` on save (`:667`) TRUE; `title` default "Line Items" (`i18n/src/locales/en.ts:299`) TRUE; `readonly` locks cells, hides Save, blocks add and delete (`:706`, `:707`, `:723`, `:810`) TRUE; `filter` AND-combined, never substituted (`:515`-`:520`, `mergeFilterNodes`) TRUE; `sort` storage-order default TRUE; `limit` default 500 and no pagination (`DEFAULT_LINE_ITEMS_LIMIT = 500`, `:137`) TRUE. Two FALSE items, both outside the shipped strings: (i) the comment sentence "the last registered `record:*` renderer without a `ComponentPropsMap` row" (D3 entry header comment, the map row comment, the lint test comment) is FALSE as written, because the pinned objectui also registers `record:approvals` and `record:attachments` (`app-shell/src/views/record-approvals-renderer.tsx:80`, `record-attachments-renderer.tsx:69`, console-internal, `inputs: [className]`, absent from `public-blocks.ts`), neither of which has a row; it is TRUE read as "the last PUBLISHED `record:*` block without a row". (ii) The Nested Shape hydration describes discussed above. Neither moves the verdict.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/spec: minor` with the BREAKING banner, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` in the changeset body, adr-0087 marker `registered ui-record-line-items-props-closed`. The narrowing arm is the right one: the accept set shrinks from any bag to a strict fifteen-key shape; the new exports widen the TypeScript surface, but the closed pair takes one arm and the breaking arm governs. Pre-GA `minor` is what ADR-0087's 2026-09-13 amendment and `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` require for a metadata-facing narrowing. The registered id is new in the diff, lands in `migrations/registry.ts` step 18 with its rationale fragment at `order: 57` (the only `order: 57`, no collision), and the regenerated registry entry is byte-identical to the entry file. The FROM-to-TO table and one-line fix are present and match the refusals. The PR body's `Clause-②: yes` omits the arm the changeset carries; the gate reads the arm from the changeset, so the declaration stands. Level and declaration MATCH the diff.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev deviations, each answered. (1) File surface beyond the claim's list (three lint files, the carrier test, the new showcase test, the rationale fragment): each is a consequence of the row and none changes behaviour; accepted. (2) Guidance for four detail-entry keys: measured unread at the pin above; accepted. (3) `filters: 'filter'` spelled inline instead of spreading `FILTERS_TO_FILTER`: the const is declared at `component.zod.ts:3569`, below this schema, so the TDZ account under `OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS=1` is plausible; no spec test enumerates doors by that constant (`component.test.ts:3451` holds a fixed `object-*` list, and the map-wide pin at `:2461` enumerates by shape and admits this door); accepted with the comment left in place. (4) Commit trailers: outside this review's remit. (5) The `dropped-refinements` baseline row the dispatch did not expect: verified correct and arithmetically consistent above; accepted.

`open_questions`: none declared; none found that this diff must answer.

`out_of_scope_findings`, each with its carrier. (1) The objectui mirror (`public-blocks.zod.ts:167`, registry `inputs` 5 of 15): carrier objectui#10872, named; accepted. (2) Footer total shown only with `totalField` at the pin, with `amountField` alone on objectui main: carrier the next `.objectui-sha` bump, named; the `amountField` describe is TRUE at the pin; accepted. (3) `parentId` / `recordId` as two read spellings of one concept: both read at `:228`, declared as measured on the `initialValues` / `initialData` precedent; carrier none; accepted as an enforce-or-remove note the seat may card separately. (4) `field-no-consumers` walks `subforms` / `details` only and does not credit a `record:line_items` column to the child object: ESCALATED. With a typed row landed, a child field whose only consumer is a line-items column is a reproducible lint false positive, which Prime Directive #10 names as a card, not a note; the dispatching seat should file it.

Flags raised by this review, none verdict-moving. (a) The shared column describes carry hydration wording this carrier contradicts; a `data/field.zod.ts` rewording to carrier-neutral text would make the Nested Shape rows true on all four carriers. (b) Three comments the diff leaves stale: `component.zod.ts:153` ("unregistered types like `record:line_items` are authored in the wild"), `validate-component-types.ts:44` ("the ledgered `record:line_items`"), `validate-page-field-bindings.ts:31` ("unregistered types like `record:line_items` parse"). (c) The "last registered `record:*` renderer" comment wording, see ① (`record:approvals`, `record:attachments`). (d) ADR-0087: whether the 2026-09-12 option-B filter ruling should extend `RULE_ARRAY_FILTER_BLOCK_TYPES` to this block's `filter` door is a ruling for the maintainer, with zero authored population measured and deployed metadata unmeasured; this diff owes no D2 under the disposition read above.

Check-runs on the head at the final read (2026-10-01T21:36:59Z, REST `commits/c2b9101…/check-runs`): 35 runs, 33 `success`, 2 `skipped` (`Console Pin Gate`, which this diff does not trigger since the pin is untouched and nothing the pinned sibling imports is removed; `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`, not opted in), 0 failed, 0 still running. `Lint & Repo Gates` (which carries `check:adr-0087-registration`, `check:changeset-no-major`, `check:spec-parsed-alias` and `check:migration-registry`), `Spec property liveness`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Build Core`, the six `Test Core` shards, the three Dogfood shards, `Temporal Conformance` and the four type-check lanes are all `success`. No governed surface is in the file list, so no tier applies to the landing beyond this record.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `75f98b26a43fa1d485285b05a0eda306bcc13fb9`
Local-runs: none

Rendered 2026-10-01T23:48Z by an isolated reviewer, as a fresh record on the merged head: the pure-regeneration carry does not apply, because the hand-maintained `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json` moved in the merge resolution. Inputs: card #21142 (body and all six comments: the triage grade `5929028089`, the claim `5937827924`, the first dev report `5940709575`, the ACCEPT on the earlier head `5941249538`, the dequeue note `5941361013`, the base-merge round report `5942723870`), PR #21244 (body, 22-file list, both comments including the earlier record `5941164801`, and the net diff `origin/main...refs/review/21142` with the fetched ref equal to the head above), and the check-runs on the head. The dispatch order and the dispatching seat's own conclusions were not read. Nothing was built, run or re-run; every git read below is `git diff`, `git show`, `git log` or `git merge-tree --write-tree` against fetched objects, with no checkout and no worktree.

### ① Derived judgments

**The delta first.** The head is the regeneration commit on top of merge 21c74a7d, whose parents are the reviewed head c2b9101398cce19e72815d0d0837eaa2db672340 and `main` at 4727fcb2. The net diff (merge-base 4727fcb2) is 22 files, +797 / -61: the same file set and the same per-file stat as the reviewed diff (`62b90d74...c2b91013`). Comparing the two diffs file by file with hunk headers and context stripped: 13 files carry byte-identical hunks, every hand-written one among them (`component.zod.ts`, `component-type-vocabulary.ts` and its test, `inline-grid-column-carriers.test.ts`, the D3 entry `18.ui-record-line-items-props-closed.ts`, the four lint files, the showcase page and its new test, the changeset, and `component.mdx`).
